note.completionDefinition: reader-visible official paid note page verified with title, price, paid boundary and dedicated cover image
note.catchUpPriority: oldest verified-unpublished qualified paid fallback first

operationalState.pcAssumption: After 01:00 JST do not assume the Windows publisher is online. Preserve publication debt and keep paid inventory ready for the first Windows-available session.
operationalState.queueMaterializationState: complete_manuscripts_present; encrypted Windows queue materialization still required before publication
operationalState.fallbackPolicy: Continue across the complete five-item paid batch. A brief recoverable failure on one item must not block later items. Do not stop after the first strict publication while quota remains.
operationalState.debtRule: Only reader-visible verification of URL, exact title, expected price, paid boundary and dedicated cover decrements paid debt or counts toward the paid daily target.

freeAcquisitionExperiment.strictFreePublicationDefinition: reader-visible official note page verified with exact title, free state and dedicated cover image
freeAcquisitionExperiment.adaptationRule: 2/day is only an initial test cadence. Increase, maintain or reduce based on comparable post-publication traffic, engagement and paid-conversion evidence; never invent missing metrics.
freeAcquisitionExperiment.separationRule: Free publications never decrement paid publication debt and never replace the paid 5/day strict floor.

BOOTH.completionDefinition: buyer-visible official BOOTH product page verified with title, price, downloadable-product state and purchase path
BOOTH.catchUpPriority: complete current-day genuine-new paid batch before deferred legacy blockers

operationalState.pcAssumption: After 01:00 JST do not assume the Windows publisher is online. Preserve publication debt and build encrypted paid inventory in the cloud for the first Windows-available session.
operationalState.materializationState: workflow_requested; do not count until encrypted queue files exist and buyer-visible strict publication is verified
operationalState.fallbackPolicy: Process the genuine-new current-day batch. After each strict success move immediately to the next ledger-absent item. Do not return to deferred legacy blockers while current-day quota remains.
operationalState.debtRule: Only explicit verification of all required buyer checks on a newly published item decrements debt. Generic publisher success, local logs, drafts, commits, old-item reverification, or HTTP/title-only verification does not.

rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and must not be silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
A paid scheduled slot that cannot reach verified publication is not discarded; it becomes paid publication debt.
Paid publication debt survives date changes and PC power-off periods until buyer/reader-visible publication is verified.
Previous-day paid debt must be serviced before treating the current day's paid quota as satisfied.
One run may complete multiple publications when debt exists; pacing preferences are not production caps.
Do not count queue insertion, local publisher success logs, editor/admin URLs, drafts, commits, old-item reverification, or unverified pages as completed paid publications.
Free note articles are an additional acquisition and validation layer, not a substitute for paid publication floors.
Cloud-side planning, article production, product production, encryption, build preparation, queue production and repair continue after 01:00 JST even when the Windows PC is expected to be off.
Do not disable BOOTH/note cloud automation because of a recoverable publication or verification delay.
If one paid candidate remains blocked, defer it and switch to another qualified candidate rather than ending a production run without progress.
